name: Latent volatility
formula: high if filtered P(high) >= 0.5; order states by unconditional variance

name: Equity market
formula: P(t)/P(t-60)-1; below -0.05 bear, above +0.05 bull, otherwise stable

name: Monetary policy
formula: Latest published decision: cut/easing, unchanged/hold, hike/tightening; retain until next decision

name: Inflation momentum
formula: Latest released YoY minus previous released YoY; below -0.25 pp falling, above +0.25 pp rising, otherwise stable

name: Economic growth
formula: Latest released IIP YoY below -1 pp contraction, above +1 pp expansion, otherwise stable

name: INR pressure
formula: Prior-date quote aligned strictly to next Indian session, then 20-session return; below -0.01 appreciation, above +0.01 depreciation

name: Commodity cycle
formula: Equal category weights and equal within-category weights of daily log returns divided by training SD; sum 60 sessions, classify by training 0.33/0.67 quantiles

name: Rates and liquidity
formula: Spread in percentage points; below training q0.33 loose, above q0.67 tight, otherwise neutral

name: Risk sentiment
formula: Current India VIX below prior 252-session q0.25 risk_on, above q0.75 risk_off, otherwise neutral; exclude current observation from thresholds

name: Network leadership
formula: Rolling lag-5 HAC Granger p<0.05 direction counts. Balance=(out-in)/(out+in). Fewer than 3 links is diffuse; otherwise balance >0.2 hub_led, <-0.2 stock_led, else diffuse. Zero tested directions is unavailable.
